node.title: Re^2: "indir" in shebang line
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
it is pretty much out-of-date

Sorry, but I find this quite misleading. [doc://perlrun] is, like most of the Perl documentation, [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/history/HEAD:/pod/perlrun.pod|regularly maintained]. While the feature it is documenting may be a vestige, the feature is still present and so the documentation is in fact accurate.
